player_prompt.intro:
O tlile go tshameka Countdown numbers game!
Mmuledi: Latela dinomoro ka go tsaya +, -, *, / go fitlhela thebe.
Tsela ya tshono: [i j op] fa i,j ke tsenyane le op ke tiro.
Senepe: [0 2 *] e bapala nomoro ya tsenyane 0 le nomoro ya tsenyane 2.
Tshireletso ga go tlhokege boraro fela.
